title: Bell and House
author: Orsen Halloran
blurb: Jude Pemberton, the new teacher at a school with a missing-class problem, has spent twenty years telling themselves the noises have explanations. But when every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must learn the song's last verse without singing along, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
